mapper.select: SELECT FROM coupon_campaigns WHERE enabled AND starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND issued<supply ORDER BY starts_at DESC,id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM coupon_campaigns WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY starts_at DESC,id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM coupon_campaigns WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_campaigns SET enabled=FALSE WHERE id=#{id} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId}
UPDATE coupon_campaigns SET issued=issued+1 WHERE id=#{campaignId} AND enabled AND starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND issued<supply
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM customer_coupons WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND campaign_id=#{campaignId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: c.id,c.campaign_id,c.customer_id,a.merchant_id,a.title,a.minimum_amount,a.discount_amount, a.starts_at,a.expires_at,a.enabled, CASE WHEN c.status='AVAILABLE' AND a.expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE c.status END AS status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer_coupons c JOIN coupon_campaigns a ON a.id=c.campaign_id WHERE c.customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY c.claimed_at DESC,c.id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM customer_coupons c JOIN coupon_campaigns a ON a.id=c.campaign_id WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.customer_id=#{customerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_coupons SET status='HELD',bound_quote=#{quoteId} WHERE id=#{id} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='AVAILABLE'

UPDATE customer_coupons c SET status=CASE WHEN #{consumed} THEN 'USED' WHEN a.expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END, bound_quote=CASE WHEN #{consumed} THEN #{quoteId} ELSE NULL END FROM coupon_campaigns a WHERE a.id=c.campaign_id AND c.id=#{id} AND c.status='HELD' AND c.bound_quote=#{quoteId}
